reference: assets/references/sommeil.webp (catalogue/cinema.json image; credit QAGOMA / Dovidis). Used for study and comparison only; never copied, traced or composited.

neutrality.note: pure neutral greyscale, no tone or tint

spatial.read: bright pale wall fills the left ~40%; a deep shadow mass fills the right ~50%; the head sits on the boundary

texture.read: fine silver-gelatin grain, visible only in midtones; flat highlights almost clean

framing: close-up: one head and shoulders, head height about 0.48 of frame height, slumped against a wall/door-jamb edge; shallow space; a doubled back-turned figure (mirror) occupies the dark side
light: hard single key from frame left/front (window or flash), fast falloff to the right, cast shadow of the head on the wall

targets_for_film_frames.frac_below_60_and_above_220: each within +/-0.12 of the reference on the S3/S4 frames; combined (below60+above220) >= 0.55 on S3/S4
targets_for_film_frames.grain: no added grain: highpass std on a flat wall patch of a film frame must not exceed the same patch of the graded source plate (resampled to film scale) by more than 0.5
